name: artsick
source:
Eugene is finishing the last year of his Bachelor’s degree in fine arts, and he feels like he can explode any second. The concepts of his works are good, he always gets good feedback, and no one ever questions his skill - but why do his paintings feel the emptiest they have ever been? Eugene is fueled even more by the success of his peer, May, who keeps booking new exhibitions one after another. The envy burns Eugene stronger and stronger every day - but maybe it’s something else that keeps him so focused on his rival?

Meanwhile, Eugene’s friend Anne is going through a rough breakup, and May can’t stand Eugene not being his friend anymore.

What can help? A good old art retreat.

[from [url=https://ulutoyon.itch.io/artsick]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尤金即将完成美术学士学位的最后一年，他感觉自己随时都会爆发。他的作品构思很好，反馈也很好，也没有人质疑他的技巧——但为什么他的画给人一种最空虚的感觉呢？尤金的同事梅的成功让尤金更加兴奋，梅不断预订新的展览。嫉妒每天都让尤金变得越来越强烈——但也许还有其他什么东西让他如此专注于他的对手？

与此同时，尤金的朋友安妮正在经历一场艰难的分手，而梅无法忍受尤金不再是他的朋友。

有什么可以帮忙的？一个很好的老艺术静修处。
